answer_2.quote: we propose to use mutation testing as a proxy for measuring completeness of LLM-generated specifications... This fraction is defined as the Completeness Rate (CR) of the specification.

answer_4.quote: To further validate its suitability, we compared our completeness metric with human judgment: annotators labeled 8 of 20 LLM-generated specifications as complete and 12 as incomplete.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled specifications as complete or incomplete and selected the more complete specification in pairwise comparisons.
